---
title: "DESeq2 Contrast Report"
output:
  html_document:
    df_print: paged
params:
  context_path: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(plotly)
  library(DT)
  library(htmltools)
  library(knitr)
  library(tibble)
})

context <- readRDS(params$context_path)

sig_mask <- function(df, alpha, lfc_threshold) {
  !is.na(df$adjusted_pvalue) &
    df$adjusted_pvalue < alpha &
    !is.na(df$log2FoldChange_shrunk) &
    abs(df$log2FoldChange_shrunk) >= lfc_threshold
}

ordered_hits <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      abs_lfc = abs(.data$log2FoldChange_shrunk),
      padj_sort = ifelse(is.na(.data$adjusted_pvalue), Inf, .data$adjusted_pvalue)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data$padj_sort, dplyr::desc(.data$abs_lfc))
}

lfc_axis_label <- function(section) {
  if (isFALSE(section$shrinkage_applied)) {
    "log2 fold change (unshrunk -- shrinkage failed)"
  } else {
    "Shrunken log2 fold change"
  }
}

make_volcano <- function(section, alpha, lfc_threshold, label_top_n) {
  # adjusted_pvalue (BH-corrected from the raw pvalue column, computed once in
  # run_deseq2_contrast_report.R) can underflow to exactly 0 for very small
  # p-values, which would make -log10(adjusted_pvalue) infinite; clamp to the
  # smallest representable positive double instead of dropping the point (an
  # NA_real_ fallback would make the most significant hits invisible on the
  # plot while still being counted as significant).
  df <- section$results %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      significant = sig_mask(section$results, alpha, lfc_threshold),
      direction = dplyr::case_when(
        .data$significant & .data$log2FoldChange_shrunk > 0 ~ paste("Up in", context$group1),
        .data$significant & .data$log2FoldChange_shrunk < 0 ~ paste("Up in", context$group2),
        TRUE ~ "Not significant"
      ),
      neg_log10_padj = dplyr::if_else(
        !is.na(.data$adjusted_pvalue),
        -log10(pmax(.data$adjusted_pvalue, .Machine$double.xmin)),
        NA_real_
      ),
      feature_label = section$feature_labels
    )

  top_labels <- ordered_hits(df %>% dplyr::filter(.data$significant)) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = label_top_n)

  plot_obj <- ggplot(df, aes(
    x = .data$log2FoldChange_shrunk,
    y = .data$neg_log10_padj,
    color = .data$direction,
    text = paste0(
      .data$feature_label,
      "<br>padj: ", signif(.data$adjusted_pvalue, 3),
      "<br>log2FC: ", signif(.data$log2FoldChange_shrunk, 3)
    )
  )) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_threshold, lfc_threshold), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(alpha), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = setNames(
        c("#c0392b", "#1f618d", "#9e9e9e"),
        c(paste("Up in", context$group1), paste("Up in", context$group2), "Not significant")
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      x = lfc_axis_label(section),
      y = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
      color = "Call"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

  if (nrow(top_labels) > 0) {
    plot_obj <- plot_obj +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
        data = top_labels,
        aes(label = .data$feature_label),
        size = 3,
        show.legend = FALSE,
        max.overlaps = Inf
      )
  }

  plotly::ggplotly(plot_obj, tooltip = "text")
}

make_ma <- function(section) {
  df <- section$results %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      significant = sig_mask(section$results, context$config$alpha, context$config$lfc_threshold),
      direction = dplyr::case_when(
        .data$significant & .data$log2FoldChange_shrunk > 0 ~ paste("Up in", context$group1),
        .data$significant & .data$log2FoldChange_shrunk < 0 ~ paste("Up in", context$group2),
        TRUE ~ "Not significant"
      )
    )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data$baseMean, y = .data$log2FoldChange_shrunk, color = .data$direction)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = setNames(
        c("#c0392b", "#1f618d", "#9e9e9e"),
        c(paste("Up in", context$group1), paste("Up in", context$group2), "Not significant")
      )
    ) +
    labs(x = "baseMean", y = lfc_axis_label(section), color = "Call") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
}

make_pca <- function(section) {
  if (is.null(section$pca_data) || nrow(section$pca_data) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  ggplot(section$pca_data, aes(x = .data$PC1, y = .data$PC2, color = .data$group, label = .data$sample)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
    labs(
      x = paste0("PC1 (", section$percent_var[[1]], "%)"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", section$percent_var[[2]], "%)"),
      color = "Group"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
}

make_sample_distance <- function(section) {
  if (is.null(section$sample_distance)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  dist_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(section$sample_distance))
  colnames(dist_df) <- c("sample_x", "sample_y", "distance")

  ggplot(dist_df, aes(x = .data$sample_x, y = .data$sample_y, fill = .data$distance)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Blues", direction = 1) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Distance")
}

summary_table <- function(section) {
  tibble::tibble(
    metric = c(
      "Features tested",
      "Significant",
      paste("Up in", context$group1),
      paste("Up in", context$group2)
    ),
    value = c(
      section$summary$n_features_tested,
      section$summary$n_significant,
      section$summary$n_up_group1,
      section$summary$n_up_group2
    )
  )
}

top_hits_table <- function(section, top_n) {
  ordered_hits(section$results) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n)
}

full_results_table <- function(section, max_rows) {
  if (nrow(section$results) <= max_rows) {
    return(section$results)
  }
  section$results %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = max_rows)
}

download_link <- function(section) {
  htmltools::tags$p(
    htmltools::tags$a(
      href = basename(section$output_path),
      target = "_blank",
      "Download TSV"
    )
  )
}
```

# `r context$comparison`

```{r overview, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(
  tibble::tibble(
    field = c("Group 1", "Group 2", "Contrast file", "Alpha", "LFC threshold"),
    value = c(
      context$group1,
      context$group2,
      basename(context$contrast_file),
      context$config$alpha,
      context$config$lfc_threshold
    )
  )
)
```

## Samples

```{r samples, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(context$sample_table)
```

```{r render-sections, echo=FALSE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
render_section <- function(section, section_title) {
  if (isTRUE(section$skipped)) {
    icon <- if (identical(section$skip_type, "skip_list")) "⏭️" else "⚠️"
    cat(sprintf("## %s\n\n%s %s\n\n", section_title, icon, section$reason))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  cat(sprintf("## %s\n\n", section_title))
  print(download_link(section))

  if (isFALSE(section$shrinkage_applied)) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "⚠️ **LFC shrinkage failed for this comparison** (%s) -- the `log2FoldChange_shrunk` column and all plots below show **unshrunk** log2 fold changes instead.\n\n",
      section$shrinkage_error
    ))
  }

  cat("### Summary\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(summary_table(section)))

  cat("\n### Volcano Plot\n\n")
  print(make_volcano(section, context$config$alpha, context$config$lfc_threshold, context$config$report_label_top_n))

  cat("\n### MA Plot\n\n")
  print(make_ma(section))

  cat("\n### PCA\n\n")
  pca_plot <- make_pca(section)
  if (is.null(pca_plot)) {
    cat("PCA unavailable for this section.\n\n")
  } else {
    print(pca_plot)
  }

  cat("\n### Sample Distance Heatmap\n\n")
  sample_dist_plot <- make_sample_distance(section)
  if (is.null(sample_dist_plot)) {
    cat("Sample distance heatmap unavailable for this section.\n\n")
  } else {
    print(sample_dist_plot)
  }

  cat("\n### Top Hits\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(top_hits_table(section, context$config$report_top_n)))

  cat("\n### Full Results\n\n")
  print(
    DT::datatable(
      full_results_table(section, context$config$report_max_table_rows),
      extensions = "Buttons",
      options = list(
        pageLength = 25,
        dom = "Bfrtip",
        buttons = c("copy", "csv")
      ),
      rownames = FALSE
    )
  )

  if (nrow(section$results) > context$config$report_max_table_rows) {
    cat(
      sprintf(
        "\nFull results table truncated to the first %d rows for HTML rendering.\n\n",
        context$config$report_max_table_rows
      )
    )
  }
}

if (!is.null(context$host)) {
  render_section(context$host, context$host$display_name)
}

if (length(context$viruses) > 0) {
  for (virus_name in names(context$viruses)) {
    section <- context$viruses[[virus_name]]
    render_section(section, section$display_name)
  }
}
```
